preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of roads m must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The city Bash lives in s must be a valid city number between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= w <= 10**9 for u, v, w in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities and have a valid length.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of friends who can be made unhappy by destroying exactly one city.
